ext_description.message: Clip to topmind: preview · highlights · templates · destinations · image localization · Desktop Bridge / workspace.

command_clip_selection.message: Clip selection or page to topmind

setup_step1_detail.message: Desktop → Settings → General → Browser Clip → Enable and copy Token

setup_step2_detail.message: Authorize topmind-workspace root folder in settings

hint_default.message: Clip current page or selection to topmind Inbox (Bridge or local workspace).

hint_article.message: Will clip full article (Readability) to Inbox

hint_selection.message: Will clip current selection · title stays as page

hint_highlights.message: Will clip highlighted passages (enable highlight mode first)

hint_configured_once.message: Configure once for one-click clip to Inbox

hint_needs_auth.message: Local mode: browser will re-confirm directory permission on first clip

msg_not_configured.message: Please configure Desktop Token or authorize workspace

msg_ws_needs_auth.message: Workspace selected · click "Clip" to grant write permission (once)

msg_will_write_ws.message: Will write to local workspace (Desktop optional)

msg_set_token_or_ws.message: Set Token (Bridge) or authorize workspace folder

msg_clipping_bg.message: Still clipping in background… Check toolbar badge ✓ / ✕

err_missing_token.message: Please configure Desktop Token or authorize workspace folder in settings

err_offline_no_ws.message: Desktop offline and no workspace — open settings to configure one

err_bridge_unreachable.message: Desktop Bridge unreachable — switch to "Local Workspace" mode

err_empty_content.message: No content available — select some text first then clip

err_no_highlights.message: No highlights yet — click "Highlight mode" and select on page

err_permission_denied.message: Workspace write permission not active — click "Clip" again or re-select folder in settings

err_stale_workspace.message: Workspace folder is stale (moved or deleted) — please re-select folder in settings

hl_start_hint.message: Drag-select on page to highlight · Alt+click to remove

hl_unsupported.message: Cannot enable highlights on this page (system page)

options_lead.message: Two write paths: Desktop Clip Bridge (recommended, Desktop runtime) or local workspace folder (no Desktop process required, writes Inbox per topmind conventions).

options_mode_auto.message: Auto (prefer Bridge, fall back to workspace)

options_mode_hint.message: Auto mode: Desktop online uses Bridge (better HTML→MD); offline uses authorized workspace folder.

options_bridge_step1.message: topmind Desktop → Settings → General → Browser Clip

options_ws_hint.message: Select your topmind-workspace root folder (containing 00-Inbox etc.). Browser will request read/write permission; notes are written to Inbox per conventions, frontmatter matches capture.

options_ws_perm_hint.message: Requires Chromium (Chrome / Edge). After selecting folder, click "Re-authorize write" on this page or click "Clip" in popup — browser remembers permission; Service Worker cannot prompt on its own. Local mode uses lightweight HTML→MD; Bridge mode reuses Desktop pipeline.

options_tpl_hint.message: Auto-match by URL (not full Obsidian DSL). Built-in: article · selection · bookmark · github · zhihu. Variables: title url author published site content selection highlights.

options_tpl_hint2.message: You can also paste {"templates":[...]}. Custom templates take priority over built-in domain matching (same id overwrites). When Bridge is online, popup can select Inbox / Category / Topic destination.

options_need_token.message: Please enter Token first (or switch to "Local Workspace" mode)

options_bridge_no_ws.message: Bridge online, but Desktop workspace not open

options_pick_ok.message: ✓ Workspace "$1" authorized · writable · can clip without Desktop

options_pick_need_reauth.message: ✓ Selected "$1" · click "Re-authorize write" or open popup and click "Clip" to confirm permission

options_unsupported_browser.message: Browser doesn't support directory auth (use Chrome/Edge)

options_perm_failed.message: Permission not granted — allow in browser dialog or re-select folder

options_tpl_exported_clipboard.message: Exported $1 custom templates to text box and copied

fallback_load_timeout.message: Settings page load timeout — please reload extension (chrome://extensions → refresh)
